title: New ransomware campaign targeting cloud infrastructure
description: Security researchers have identified a new ransomware variant specifically designed to target cloud-based infrastructure. The campaign uses compromised CI/CD pipelines to deploy malicious code.

title: Show HN: Open-source vulnerability scanner

description: A security flaw has been discovered in uvwt agentdock up to 1.1.1. This impacts the function runtimeAPIHandler of the file internal/httpx/runtime_api.go of the component Runtime Management API. Performing a manipulation results in missing authentication. title: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in OgreBinarySerializer:...
description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in OgreBinarySerializer::ReadGeometryVertexBuffer that allows attackers to crash applications via crafted Ogre binary .mesh files. Attackers can supply a large vertex count that wraps the 32-bit size calculation, desynchronising parsing and causing aiScene teardown to delete uninitialised mesh pointers.

title: CherryTree through 1.7.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to...
description: CherryTree through 1.7.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application through uncaught std::stoi/std::stoll exceptions on malformed XML attributes. Attackers can craft a document with non-numeric or out-of-range char_offset, frame_width, frame_height, col_max, or time attributes to repeatedly crash CherryTree and block access to content.

title: Net-SNMP snmpd through 5.9.5.2 and 5.10.pre1 before 5.10.pre3 contains a heap out-of-bounds write...
description: Net-SNMP snmpd through 5.9.5.2 and 5.10.pre1 before 5.10.pre3 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in view_parse_oid() that allows authenticated attackers with SNMP write access to corrupt heap memory. Attackers can send a single SET to vacmViewTreeFamilyTable whose index begins with sub-identifier 4294967295, causing a one-byte write before a malloc(0) allocation and crashing snmpd.

title: WinFsp before 2.2.26323 contains a kernel pool out-of-bounds write vulnerability in...
description: WinFsp before 2.2.26323 contains a kernel pool out-of-bounds write vulnerability in FspEaBufferFromFileSystemValidate that allows unprivileged local users to corrupt kernel memory via crafted extended-attribute responses. Attackers can mount a WinFsp file system and answer QueryEa or SetEa requests with malformed NextEntryOffset values, writing zero bytes past the pool allocation to crash the system.

title: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the httpout filter that allows...
description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the httpout filter that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read files outside the rdirs root by sending unnormalized request paths. Attackers can send GET or HEAD requests containing ../ or %2e%2e%2f sequences to read configuration files, TLS private keys, or credentials readable by the gpac process.

title: CherryTree through 1.7.3 contains a LaTeX rendering filter bypass vulnerability in...
description: CherryTree through 1.7.3 contains a LaTeX rendering filter bypass vulnerability in _is_latex_text_safe() that allows attackers to read local files by building blocked command names with TeX macro expansion. Attackers can craft a document with a LaTeX node using \csname verbatiminput\endcsname to render user-readable files into the embedded note image when opened.

title: emailjs 3.2.0 before 5.0.4 contains an address parsing vulnerability in addressparser that allows...
description: emailjs 3.2.0 before 5.0.4 contains an address parsing vulnerability in addressparser that allows attackers to inject hidden recipients by abusing nested comments, semicolons, or backslash escapes. Attackers can craft recipient strings that pass conformant-parser allow lists but make emailjs send RCPT TO commands to attacker-chosen addresses, disclosing message content.

title: Listmonk 2.3.0 through 7.0.0-beta.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows...
description: Listmonk 2.3.0 through 7.0.0-beta.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to view draft, scheduled or cancelled campaigns marked for archiving via the public archive page. Attackers who know or guess the campaign UUID or predictable subject-derived archive slug can request the archive page and read unpublished campaign content before it is sent.

title: Apprise before 1.12.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in NotifyEmail...
description: Apprise before 1.12.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in NotifyEmail.send that ignores verify_certificate for SMTPS and STARTTLS connections. Network-positioned attackers can present self-signed or mismatched certificates to intercept SMTP AUTH credentials and notification contents, or modify and suppress notifications.

title: ELADMIN through 2.7 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the user export endpoint...
description: ELADMIN through 2.7 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the user export endpoint that allows department-scoped users to export user records from other departments. Authenticated attackers holding user:list permission can request GET /api/users/download to obtain an XLSX containing usernames, roles, emails, and phone numbers across all departments.

title: CVE-2026-19793 - The WP Import Export Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Limited Code Injection in all versio
description: The WP Import Export Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Limited Code Injection in all versions up to, and including, 3.9.32 via the 'comment' parameter. This is due to a two-stage shortcode check that evaluates the raw mapping placeholder before data substitution, causing the neutralizer to be skipped when attacker-controlled comment content containing a malicious [wpie_function] shortcode is substituted at runtime. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary PHP callables on the server. Exploitation requires an Administrator to perform the standard Export With Settings For Import followed by a New Import migration workflow, which is a routine operational task; the attacker themselves requires no account or authentication, needing only the ability to submit a pending comment on any comments-open post.

title: CVE-2026-131651 - The rtMedia for WordPress, BuddyPress and bbPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-B
description: The rtMedia for WordPress, BuddyPress and bbPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'media_title' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.7.18 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The vulnerability is only triggerable via the Backbone.js-rendered "Load More" pagination path; the server-side PHP gallery rendering correctly escapes media_title with esc_attr() and is not affected.
